Chianti Classico

A full day through the most beautiful wine country in the world.

Chapter Three

Roma

The Eternal City

Two thousand years of history, one unforgettable week. Fountains by night, ruins by day.

Thursday · October 8

All Roads Lead Here

An evening stroll past every postcard in Rome.

  • Check out of Siena @ 10:00 AM
  • Travel to Rome
  • Check in @ 2:00 — Hotel Forum, Via Tor de' Conti 25
  • Evening walk: Campo de' Fiori → Piazza Navona → Pantheon → Trevi → Spanish Steps (about an hour)
  • Dinner near the Spanish Steps at Alla Rampa
  • Insider tip: inside Rinascente (floor -1) ask for the Aqueduct — the Aqua Vergine, built 19 BC, still feeds the Trevi today. Free to visit.
  • Make the dinner reservation
Where to eat
  • Alla RampaGreat value by the Spanish Steps (from your notes)
  • La Taverna dei Fori ImperialiRoman classics steps from Hotel Forum

  • FafiuchèMonti wine bar for the post-tour aperitivo
